items.flavor: Every hit lands harder, and the company's repair bill grows.
Trigger's at redline: more shots every second, no warranty.
Mags swap faster. Fewer seconds for the robots to enjoy.
More shots land as crits; I waved the odds away.
Crits hit harder now; corporate gets to price the extra dents.
Bigger mag, more shots before reloading. Payload, not paperwork.
More max health: another hull patch, no company warranty.
Move speed up: still in the wrong place, just leaving faster.
Grabs pickups from farther away; every scrap counts toward my cut.
XP gain up: I level up sooner, and still plan later.
Fresh drill bit, more torque: rock falls faster.
Better luck means better cards. Shaky plan, total confidence.
Like in Last Inaction Hero: each round punches through the robot queue.
